author: Nancy Jarvis
text: We are grateful to T. Palmer Septic for helping us out in a pinch!!! Such a wonderful experience and highly recommend this company! They are truly reliable, professional, caring, and experienced! We are so thankful! Sincerely, your new client!

author: Hillary Weinberg
text: Sara, thank you, thank you!!!! We just had a great experience with T. Palmer Septic Service, a fantastic family owned and operated business for 30 years. We are first time home buyers and asked a lot of questions around a dilemma we were facing and Sara was incredibly informative and helpful. Anyone would be lucky to work this company!

author: Keith
text: Septic cleaning amazing we bought this house 2 years ago installed new septic system in kept with the same company

author: Jillian Hood
text: T Palmer Septic is a great company! They are family owned and operated, knowledgeable and trustworthy. We used them for our septic inspection and was able to make a few negotations based on findings. We will be using them for the repairs as well. They're our go-to septic company!

author: Greg W
text: T Palmer Septic is great to work with. They have been servicing our septic for 12 years now. Recently when we were having some strange plumbing issues he came out on the coldest day of the year to empty the tank and snake the connection to the house; problem solved. Todd is a great guy and a straight shooter. I highly recommend him to anyone in the area who needs cleaning or a replacement system.
